name: notes
text:
notes:

TO CHANGE THE PLACEMENT OF THE TEXT SHADOW:
Two properties in the script TEXTFORMATTER determine the relative placement of the shadow to the text fields:

pishadowhoriz: sets the horizontal offset
pishadowvert:  sets the vertical offset

TO CHANGE THE COLORS OF THE TEXT MEMBERS AND THEIR SHADOWS:
There are two fields in the INTERNAL cast: WHITE and BLACK.  Set the forecolor of the text in these fields to the color (using the Director Tool Palette) you want the "white" and "black" colors to be.


GLMEMBERS:
INDEXCAST indexes the first 100 internal cast members and the 501 members of the linked cast.  It makes the global property list GLMEMBERS (property list:membernumber(property),membername(value)).  All methods that get members use this list.


SPRITE ASSIGNMENTS:
1: background
2  grid
3: exit button
4: module button
5: module button
6: text select rect

7-38 shadow components
45-76  display components
77 select graphic rect
50-103: toolbox
104: message background rect
105: message text
106: left message button
107: right message button
108: center message button
112-120 reserved for flicker and dust

SHOW CAST FILES:

link.cst contains 501 empty field cast members (containing "empty"). 
The first member is reserved for general show information.  All the other members
are available text members for adding to a show in authoring mode.
Saving a show will save a copy of link.cst in the SHOWS folder.
Playing a show will change the filename of link.cst to current.cst, and play
the show in current.cst
The method for designating the current show is to copy one of the saved shows
from the SHOWS folder to the SHOWMAN folder and rename it current.cst

FILE ERROR CHECKING:

Speaker Support Module startup checks for the presence of current.cst in the
SHOWMAN folder.  If it is not there the user is prompted to QUIT or CONTINUE.
CONTINUE enters the authoring mode and starts an empty show.

Speaker Support Module startup also checks for the presence of at least one file in the BACKGROU folder.  If there are no files in that folder the user asked to QUIT and place backgrounds in the folder.

OBJECT INHERITANCE:

GOSHOWMGR:
initialized by going into #make mode or #play mode
in #make mode ancestor is COMPONENTS object
methods are:
changepage
setshowname
importshow
saveshow
addpage
deletepage

in #play mode ancstor is DISPLAYPAGE object


COMPONENTS object:
initialized by creation of gshowmgr
its ancestor is one of these based on type:
  #textformatter
   #bulletformatter
   #projectformatter
   #backgroundformatter
main methods are:
newcomponent
selectcomponent
deletecomponent
movecomponent
new page
delete page
add page
next page (1,-1)
slaves:
initialized and put into property list plslaves on going into #make mode.

These slaves can be components object's ancestors (changed on the fly on change of component type):
  
   #textformatter: formats text components
   #bulletformatter: formats bullet components
   #projectformatter:formats project button components
   #backgroundformatter:formats background components

other useful slaves:
    #indexer: finds next member, next member name, next sprite
   #itemmover: allows drag and drop movement of items with #lefttop registration and #center registration
   #getfilelist:looks in a folder and returns a list of the files in it

ASSET SPECIFICATIONS:

Toolbox live text fields are Arial/Helvetica 10 pt.


KEY CODE INFORMATION:

left arrow = 123
right arrow = 124
up arrow = 126
down arrow = 125
the letter p = 35
backspace = 51

ikWorkKey =           13  -- "W"
ikEntertainmentKey =  14  -- "E"
ikSpeakerKey =         1  -- "S"
ikExitKey =            7  -- "X"
ikQuitKey =           12  -- "Q"


TOOLBOX FUNCTIONS INHERITANCE

All calls to the toolbox go through TOOLBOXINTERFACE.  TOOLBOXFORMATTER is the ancestor to TOOLBOXONTERFACE.

TOOLBOXINTERFACE captures all the user input and accomplishes all the changes in the toolbox display. 

TOOLBOXFORMATTER performs all the formatting functions of the toolbox on the various types of components.


ADDING PROJECTS TO BE VIEWED:

Director files can be dragged to the RSI_DEMO_SUPPORT\DEMOS folder on the root of the boot drive.  These files can be navigated to by selecting the file name when making a PROJECT bullet using the TOOLBOX in the AUTHORING mode.  Any director files must have the .dir or .dxr extension and be in the DEMOS folder in order to show up in the selection list for PROJECT bullets
